description_en: Retrieves redemption codes for channel benefits. Channel benefits are distributed and transferred in the form of redemption codes. After redemption codes are generated, the corresponding benefit quota is deducted
description_zh: 获取权益兑换码。渠道权益，将以兑换码的形式进行发放和流转。生成兑换码后，相应的权益数量将会扣减
name: GetRedeemCodes

parameters.help_en: The number of redemption codes to generate. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 需要的兑换码数量，取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: code_quantity

parameters.help_en: The benefit ID included in the redemption code. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500858.html to obtain the benefit ID
parameters.help_zh: 兑换码包含的权益ID，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500858.html获取
parameters.name: benefit_id

parameters.help_en: The channel service request credential. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500860.html to obtain the credential. Each channel service request credential can be used only once
parameters.help_zh: 渠道服务请求凭证，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2500860.html获取，每个渠道服务请求凭证使用有效次数：1次
parameters.name: request_token
